name: Golemagg the Incinerator
source: [logs: Anniversary] Melee 1,744 to 2,914 before armor under the bench's raid debuffs, a swing every 1.45 s on the tank: Warcraft Logs, 28 kills on the Anniversary Hardcore realms (Normal, 2024-12-13 to 2025-02-27): the median of 608 normal hits' unmitigatedAmount (2,274), the 5th to 95th percentile of each hit over its own kill's median (608 hits) stretched to an even roll, and the swings a second while he was on the main tank. Taken back through the debuffs the bench puts on him (attack power 805 to 601, -37 a swing, attack speed 0.833): 1,433 weapon damage, spread 0.816, a 1.21 s swing. Length: the kills' length, median 56 s (10th to 90th percentile 43 to 69). Abilities: Magma Splash 13880: a Fire DoT stacking to 50 on the tank, 50 every 3 s a stack (the Classic Era client's spell data; a 2006 Molten Core log's ticks 216 average). Double Attack 18943 (50% of his landed hits give an extra swing) is in the logs' swing rate, since its swings log as white swings.

notes: The Core Ragers are another tank's job and left out. Magma Splash is modelled as a steady 4 stacks (200 Fire every 3 s), the log's tick average, without its 93 to 107 Fire hit on each application or its armor cut (about 250 a stack, so about 1,000 at 4 stacks, client data), which the sim can't model on an event yet. Earthquake below 10% health and Pyroblast on random players are left out.

healing.notes: From the Anniversary Hardcore realms's logs (28 kills): while the boss was on the main tank, 7 healers had 5% or more of its healing (the median kill), and the healing it took from others was 1,809 a second with overheal and absorbs (37% of the heals effective), 2.17 heals and HoT ticks a second, against 711 damage taken a second. The tank's own heals (1% of its healing) are left out. Main tanks: Warrior 27, Druid 1.

raidHealing.notes: What the Anniversary Hardcore realms raids had on Golemagg the Incinerator (28 kills, Warcraft Logs): the median kill's raid of 40 with 3 tanks (2 of them on adds, who took 862 a second together, not in the events), 11 healers by Warcraft Logs' healer role (93% of the healing), each 401 HPS with overheal. The raid healed 2,069 a second (1,539 on the tanks, 496 on the rest, 50% overheal on the rest). Each non-tank took 11.9 a second after mitigation. Fight length is the 10th percentile, median and 90th percentile kill. For the healing sim to check its healer counts against.

raidSource: [logs: the Anniversary Hardcore realms] The raidDamage events with who NotTanks: Warcraft Logs, 28 kills (tools/warcraftlogs/wclcli.py raid, tools/encounters/logs/anniversary_mc_raid.json): the abilities that dealt 2% or more of the non-tanks' damage taken in 10% or more of the kills, 98% of it together, their rates scaled by 1.02 for the rest. Each is a share of the non-tanks, so the file fits any raid size. Magma Splash 13880 from Golemagg the Incinerator (15% of the non-tanks' damage, in 28 of 28 kills): 92 to 108 unmitigated, the 5th to 95th percentile stretched to an even roll; 6% of the non-tanks a cast (10th to 90th percentile 3 to 16), 1.8 landed a second on each (100% of it landing), so a cast every 2.96 s at random (the logs count 10.1 casts a minute), the first at 4 s (median) of a 56 s kill. Earthquake 19798 from Golemagg the Incinerator (12% of the non-tanks' damage, in 5 of 28 kills): 1,383 to 1,602 unmitigated, the 5th to 95th percentile stretched to an even roll; 31% of the non-tanks a cast (10th to 90th percentile 25 to 38), 1.4 landed a second on each (100% of it landing), so a cast every 65.06 s at random (the logs count 0.2 casts a minute), the first at 71 s (median) of a 56 s kill. Mangle 19820 ticks from Core Rager (5% of the non-tanks' damage, in 7 of 28 kills): 272 to 828 unmitigated, the 5th to 95th percentile stretched to an even roll; 3% of the non-tanks a cast (10th to 90th percentile 3 to 3), 0.6 landed a second on each (46% of it landing), so a cast every 72.88 s at random (the logs count 0.3 casts a minute), the first at 17 s (median) of a 56 s kill, 10 ticks 2.0 s apart. Melee 1 from Core Rager (3% of the non-tanks' damage, in 10 of 28 kills): 1,777 to 2,928 unmitigated, the 5th to 95th percentile stretched to an even roll; 3% of the non-tanks a cast (10th to 90th percentile 3 to 3), 0.3 landed a second on each (69% of it landing), so a cast every 126.02 s at random (the logs count 0.4 casts a minute), the first at 4 s (median) of a 56 s kill. Together they land 11.9 a second on each non-tank over a median kill, at the logs' mitigation, against 11.9 in the logs.
